title: [WIP] Fix duplicate title and summary in components documentation
body:
## Fix Duplicate Titles and Descriptions in Components Documentation

According to fumadocs specification, when frontmatter includes `title` and `description`, they are automatically rendered. The duplicate H1 heading and description paragraph should be removed from the content.

### Progress Checklist

- [x] Analyze all 32 component MDX files in `docs/components/`
- [x] Remove duplicate H1 headings (e.g., `# Button`, `# Text`) from all component files
- [x] Remove duplicate description paragraphs that repeat the frontmatter description
- [ ] Verify the documentation renders correctly in the site
- [ ] Take a screenshot to confirm the fix
